title: Analysis of CRAC Datasets
author: Clémentine elan-Forino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bntjmekn

steps.title: Split multiplexed FASTQ by barcodes
steps.instruction: Run pyBarcodeFilter.py with a tab‑delimited barcode list to separate reads per sample; the script strips the three random nucleotides and adds them to each read header.

steps.title: Quality filter and trim adapters
steps.instruction: Use Flexbar to remove low‑quality reads and trim the 5′ adapter (TGGAATTCTCGGGTGCCAAGG) with the specified parameters.

substeps.instruction: Command: $ flexbar -r input.fastq -f solexa -as TGGAATTCTCGGGTGCCAAGG -at 1 -ao 4 -u 3 -m 7 -n 16 -t flexbar.fastq

steps.title: Collapse PCR duplicates (optional)
steps.instruction: Run pyFastqDuplicateRemover.py on the Flexbar output to collapse reads that share identical ends and identical three‑random‑nucleotide barcodes; skip this step for analyses focused on ribosomal RNA.

steps.title: Align reads to yeast genome
steps.instruction: Map the (collapsed) FASTA file to the Saccharomyces cerevisiae genome (SGD v64, Ensembl EF4.74) with Novoalign, using the appropriate index and parameters; adjust read‑length filter if needed.

substeps.instruction: Standard alignment: $ novoalign -f flexbar_comp.fasta -s 1 -r Random -d Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.EF4.74.novoindex > flexbar_comp.novo
For exosome studies on tRNAs, consider -r Unique or -r All.
For Rrp44 CRAC datasets, replace default length filter (‑l 17) with -l 9: add "-l 9" to the command.

steps.title: Validate GTF annotation file
steps.instruction: Check that the GTF file used for downstream pyCRAC analyses is correctly formatted.

steps.title: Count reads per genomic feature
steps.instruction: Generate a hit table and RPKM‑normalized counts for each feature using pyReadCounters.py with the checked GTF file.

steps.title: Create gene‑wise pileup files
steps.instruction: Produce tab‑delimited pileup data for selected genes with pyPileup.py; specify gene list and optional flank length.

steps.title: Extract 3′ oligoadenylated reads
steps.instruction: Run the custom scripts supplied by the authors to obtain (i) a FASTA file of reads containing non‑encoded 3′ A‑tails, (ii) a text file with the oligo‑A‑to‑total‑read ratio, and (iii) a list of the non‑encoded 3′ tails.

steps.title: Tag and isolate adapter‑containing reads (optional)
steps.instruction: If the proportion of 3′ oligoadenylated reads is needed, add the "-g" flag during Flexbar trimming, then grep for those reads.

substeps.instruction: Re‑run Flexbar with "-g" to tag 3′ adapters.
